title: Follow-ups from PR #221 review (backend-trade-journal-followup-review)
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #221, tracked here so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: Extract a shared `_to_closed_trade_out(row, grade)` helper in backend/app/api/routers/portfolio.py -- get_closed_trades and record_follow_up_review each independently construct an identical 16-field ClosedTradeOut(...) from a ClosedTradeORM row + TradeGrade; this PR itself had to add the two new follow-up fields to both call sites, which a shared helper would have made a one-place change instead.

decisions.decision: The duplicated ClosedTradeOut(...) construction had grown from 16 fields (as described in the checklist, current at PR #221's time) to 18 fields by the time this task was worked -- backend-trade-grade-letter added trade_letter_grade and backend-trade-journal-entry-notes added entry_notes/strategy (net +2 after removing the original description's undercount) landed on main after PR #221 merged. Extracted _to_closed_trade_out(row: ClosedTradeORM, grade: TradeGrade) -> ClosedTradeOut covering the current full 18-field shape rather than trying to preserve some intermediate 16-field version, since the goal (one place to update when ClosedTradeOut gains/loses fields) applies equally regardless of the exact current field count.
decisions.rationale: Matching the checklist's literal '16-field' phrasing would have meant deliberately reproducing an already-stale snapshot; the helper's whole purpose (per the task description) is to make future field changes a one-place edit, so it needs to reflect ClosedTradeOut's actual current shape, not the shape at PR #221 review time.
